chunks: In this way the sentence of your Lord against the infidels that they would be the inmates of Hell, was justified.
ai.seo_question: What is the divine decree regarding the disbelievers in Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the 'establishment' (haqqat) of the divine word, signifying that the decree of Hellfire for disbelievers is not merely a future promise but a settled reality resulting from their own rejection of truth. It underscores the justice of Allah, where the punishment is a direct consequence of the disbelievers' persistent denial, aligning with the concept of 'fitrah' and the logical outcome of turning away from divine guidance.
